title: Microsoft Intune: custom compliance for macOS using a discovery script and JSON file
summary: The briefing passes: the admin paths, policy opt-in, licensing requirement and published limits are supported, and it correctly reports the disagreement between the roadmap and Learn. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft licensing guidance and remove a reporting checklist step that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans macOS custom compliance using a discovery script and JSON file for organisational requirements.
claims.quote: This feature will enable users to use discovery script and json file to define compliance policy to specific organziational needs.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the experience as mirroring Windows and Linux custom compliance.
claims.quote: The experience mirrors Windows and Linux custom compliance experience.
